source: {0} writes nothing if a value drops or adds a placeholder. It lists the problems and exits with code 1. The check then finds syntax errors, such as an ICU plural without an {1} case.
text: 如果某个值丢失或多出了占位符，{0} 不会写入任何内容。它会列出问题并以退出码 1 退出。随后检查会发现语法错误，例如缺少 {1} 分支的 ICU plural。
